headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a shutout loss, while the Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees in a thrilling 2-1 victory. The Atlanta Braves also secured a decisive win over the Texas Rangers. 

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Baltimore Orioles transferring Chris Bassitt to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. Other notable injuries include JoJo Romero of the St. Louis Cardinals, Brent Rooker of the Athletics, Brice Matthews of the Houston Astros, Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies, Tommy Troy of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Rob Zastryzny of the Milwaukee Brewers, and Drew Millas of the Washington Nationals.

Several teams made roster moves, including the Baltimore Orioles acquiring outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a significant trade, acquiring Lance McCullers Jr., Colton Gordon, and cash from the Houston Astros in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, securing a decisive victory. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 5-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox took down the Tampa Bay Rays 5-3, securing a crucial win. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, securing a crucial win. Max Muncy led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Gerrit Cole pitched 6 strong innings for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, securing a decisive win. Chris Sale led the Braves' pitching effort, throwing 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. The move comes after Bassitt was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Rudy Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash. Martin Jr. joins the Orioles after being traded from the Royals.
